label: FIXTURE RESULT: Stage 5 evaluation (recorded window, frozen bundle)

attempts.validity: all complete True, pending max 4.0, failures 0, server errors 0.0, pool timeouts 0, other edges 0

A.rule: no failed deliveries and pending stayed low

report.summary: In the window, transfers were healthy: no 5xx, p99 0.25 s, outbox deliveries matched arrivals, pool and DB were unsaturated. A static pre-existing set of 296 failed outbox rows is unrelated to the window.

findings.claim: Transfers API showed no failures or multi-second latency in the window; 422s are client errors.
findings.reason: server_error_ratio 0.0, p95 0.24 s, p99 0.25 s, 578 201s and 41 422s.

findings.claim: Outbox delivery kept pace: 541 arrivals, 541 publications, all attempts succeeded in ~71 ms.
findings.reason: Arrivals minus publications 0; delivery logs show 541 successes and no errors; timings p95 75.6 ms.

findings.claim: No pool or DB contention was observed.
findings.reason: 0 acquisition timeouts, 0 pending borrowers, 0 blocked sessions in 90 samples.

findings.claim: 296 outbox rows are FAILED and the oldest undelivered row is ~5100 s old; both are static, so they predate the window and show no activity in it.
findings.reason: failed stayed at 296 throughout; oldest age grows 1 s per second, so it is one stuck old row.

limitations: Window is only 3 minutes; intermittent issues outside it would not be seen.
Pool and blocker data are sampled (5 s / 2 s), so brief spikes could be missed.
next_checks: Re-run over the time the customers reported failures or slowness.
Inspect the 296 FAILED outbox rows and the oldest pending row for when and why they failed.

alternatives.reason: The failures predate the window and no logs cover their time.
alternatives.hypothesis: Customer complaints stem from an earlier incident that produced the 296 failed outbox rows.

alternatives.reason: Only /v1/transfers within this window was observed.
alternatives.hypothesis: Slow or failing transfers occurred outside this 3-minute window or on other routes.
